observation.depicts: First-person view in a sunlit pine forest holding a wooden stick, a shirtless figure with a red skeleton overlay in shadow, and a cheat-menu panel down the left side.
observation.text_readable: Readable: "Spawn Menu", "Bone ESP", "Draw Distance: 500", "NEW ITEMS AVAILABLE TO CRAFT. PRESS B TO OPEN SURVIVAL BOOK". Some menu tab text is clipped ("Evironmen") and a green label near the slider is too small to read.
observation.composition: Menu column occupies the left quarter; the figure is centre-left in shadow; stick runs diagonally from bottom-right to upper-centre. Bottom-right holds a circular status gauge; bottom-left carries two message lines.
observation.tone_and_contrast: Strong light and shadow: bright foliage and grass against dark shade. The figure is dark on dark, separated mainly by thin red lines. Menu panel is translucent over foliage.
observation.sharpness_and_artifacts: Foliage detail is sharp. Debug/cheat menu, red bone-outline overlay, on-screen survival-book messages and a status gauge are baked in. Hand at bottom edge is cut off. No watermark seen. Some noise in shadow areas.
observation.scan_first_read: A forest survival game with a mod menu overlay and a red skeleton drawn on a person; the overlay UI competes with the scene.

legend.0: Far too few pixels or very soft: detail is mushy or blocky even at the file's native size
legend.1: Small or soft: visible softness or coarse pixels at native size; would look weak enlarged or on high-density screens
legend.2: Adequate: acceptable at native size but with little headroom for enlargement
legend.3: Good: sharp at native size with reasonable headroom
legend.4: Excellent: crisp with ample pixels; holds up when enlarged

legend.1: Only a few large words are readable; most meaningful text is illegible
legend.2: The main text is readable but secondary text is hard to read
legend.3: All meaningful text is readable with slight effort
legend.4: All text is crisp and effortless to read

legend.2: The subject is identifiable with some effort
